checks.title: Archive product base: status 0->1 qua POST /api/products/{id}/archive, khong dialog xac nhan
steps: O row menu '...', chon 'Mark as archive'
Quan sat co dialog xac nhan khong
Quan sat request POST /api/products/{id}/archive + response
checks.expected_result: Khong co dialog xac nhan; POST /api/products/{id}/archive chay ngay, status doi tu 0 sang 1

checks.title: Duplicate product base (clone) deep-copy dung printarea/variant/mockup/display settings voi ID moi
checks.precondition: Co 1 product base nguon co it nhat 1 printarea, 1 variant, 1 mockup, va cau hinh Display settings
steps: Chon 'Duplicate product' tren product base nguon
Quan sat response POST /api/products/{id}/clone
Refetch list, tim ban sao moi, doi chieu voi nguon
checks.observation_point: So sanh ban sao voi nguon: title, label, internal_tags, printarea, variant, mockup, Display settings
checks.expected_result: Ban sao co: title = title goc + ' copy'; label va internal_tags GIU NGUYEN; printarea moi (id moi, sao chep name/width/height/position); variant moi (id moi, SKU GIU NGUYEN); mockup moi (id moi); cau hinh Display settings (enable_custom_printarea, color_custom_label, colors_position, sizes_position) deu duoc sao chep

checks.title: Delete product base (truong hop allowed): dialog xac nhan + deletion-check truoc + DELETE tra 204
checks.precondition: Co 1 product base da archive, KHONG duoc campaign nao dung
steps: Chon 'Delete product'
Quan sat request GET /api/products/{id}/deletion-check (ky vong policy='allowed')
Quan sat dialog 'Delete Product / Are you sure you want to delete product <ten>?'
Xac nhan, quan sat request DELETE /api/products/{id}
checks.expected_result: deletion-check tra {policy:'allowed', reason:null, token:null}; dialog xac nhan hien ra voi ten product; sau khi xac nhan, DELETE /api/products/{id} tra 204 khong body

checks.title: RUI RO P1: DELETE product base khi deletion-check.policy='blocked' (IN_CAMPAIGNS) - server co thuc su chan khong
checks.precondition: Co 1 product base dang duoc it nhat 1 campaign dung (deletion-check.policy du kien = 'blocked')
steps: Goi GET /api/products/{id}/deletion-check tren product base dang duoc campaign dung, xac nhan policy='blocked'
Quan sat UI hien thi gi (co cho phep bam Delete tiep khong, message gi)
(Neu policy cho phep an toan) Thu goi DELETE /api/products/{id} that su, quan sat response: server co tu chan (vd 409/403) hay van xoa (204)?
checks.observation_point: UI response khi policy='blocked' + response cua DELETE that su (neu thuc hien duoc)
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra, day la control bao ve du lieu quan trong chua duoc kiem chung
checks.open_question: GET /api/products/{id}/deletion-check tra {policy:'blocked', reason:'IN_CAMPAIGNS', token:null} khi product dang duoc campaign dung (KB-058, quan sat qua probe READ-ONLY tren product 3181/campaign 2592). Run CTX-20260910-04 KHONG goi DELETE that tren asset nay (nam trong forbidden_actions cua mutation policy SAFE_REVERSIBLE_ONLY, gan ranh gioi publish_live). Hoan toan CHUA CO EVIDENCE server co tu chan DELETE khi policy=blocked hay day chi la goi y cho UI (nghia la client tu kiem tra truoc, con server van chap nhan DELETE neu goi thang). Neu server KHONG tu chan, day la lo hong nghiem trong (co the xoa product dang duoc dung boi campaign live). Can PO/Dev xac nhan hoac 1 run rieng voi mutation policy phu hop.
risk_refs: KB-058 unverified-server-enforcement HIGH - uu tien P1 theo chi dinh cua nguoi dieu phoi run CTX-20260910-04

checks.title: Response cua POST /api/products/{id}/clone tra ve record NGUON, khong phai ban sao vua tao

steps: Goi 'Duplicate product' tren product base nguon

Xac nhan portal biet id ban sao bang cach nao (refetch list hay tu response)

checks.title: Muc dich cua field 'token' trong response deletion-check - luon null o ca 2 branch
checks.precondition: Co the goi deletion-check tren ca product allowed va blocked
steps: Goi deletion-check tren product base khong dung boi campaign (allowed), ghi nhan gia tri token
Goi deletion-check tren product base dang dung boi campaign (blocked), ghi nhan gia tri token
Tim trong code/docs (neu co the) muc dich cua field nay
checks.observation_point: Gia tri field token o ca 2 branch
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: Field 'token' trong response deletion-check luon null o CA 2 sample quan sat duoc (allowed va blocked). Muc dich va dieu kien de co gia tri chua ro - co the lien quan toi mot luong xac nhan xoa (vd token dung mot lan cho DELETE) chua duoc kich hoat trong run nay. Can lam ro truoc khi coi luong delete la an toan/day du, dac biet lien quan toi CHK-07-004 (server enforcement).
